notes: vMLX 1.6.36 — DeepSeek V4 Flash visible-response and native SSD-cache reliability. Fixes foreground replies waiting behind cache re-key work, zero-sized native DSV4 cache anchors failing durable writes, tool-result schema loss, and multimodal/mixed-attention prefix selection. SSD blocks now stream without full-cache copies or retained writer buffers, use physical-block dedupe, and keep each model's architecture-native full-precision cache format; SSD-only app defaults keep in-RAM paged, vision, and SSM payload caches disabled. Tahoe/macOS 26 is the default; Sequoia remains available as compatibility. Both DMGs are Developer ID signed, notarized, stapled, and Gatekeeper verified.
